title: •Boba Fett
caption: •Boba Fett (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. May ‘fly’ (landspeed = 3). Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Your cards with “Bounty” in title are immune to Aim High. During your control phase, may ▲ a card with “Bounty” in title. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Feared *bounty hunter*. Collected bounties on Solo from both the Empire and Jabba the Hutt. Took exquisite pleasure in using Solo’s friend to capture him.

notes: Unique. The slip's heading reads '•Boba Fett ( [VS6 set sphere] persona only) (V)' — the sphere is the slip's own Original Virtual set symbol printed inline ({ovs}); the bottom strip prints only '•Boba Fett (V)' (caption). The heading is recorded in 'heading'. Stats POWER 4 / ABILITY 3 / ARMOR 5 (third box is a value box, ARMOR 5); deploy 4 / forfeit 7. Yellow (DS) pilot-power icon followed by '3.' at the start → {pilot:3} (stub expands 'Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots'); the slip prints ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Curly single quotes around ‘fly’ and curly double quotes around “Bounty” (twice). Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow DS helmet), warrior (blue, blaster). Alien (Cloud City grey alien frame; printed icons Pilot, Warrior). The wiki's default 'Boba Fett' page carries Glossary Supplement errata text; printed face = 'Boba Fett (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set/stats). The only Cloud City scan on the wiki, CC-D-bobafett.gif (745 px), is tagged D-E1 (PC errata face) — its stats and game text match the printed Original text, but it prints 'bounty hunter' in bold in the lore (errata-face styling; no decipher-archive scan exists), so it is used as src with that caveat. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Solo’s (wiki straight). Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: V6-D-bobafett.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 6 remake); VB1-D-bobafett.gif and VB2-D-bobafett.gif (350) also exist, not downloaded. SE-D-bobafett.gif is the Special Edition Boba Fett, a different card. Lore emphasis checked against the printed card (2026-10-13): bold 'bounty hunter' (period not bold). Heading sphere is the Cloud City set symbol (checked against set-cloudcity-grainy.png, 2026-10-13).
